name: Better Fullstack analytics
description: Project creation, selected ecosystems and libraries, and passive page engagement. Private owner reporting. SQL tiles use the explicit UTC ranges in their descriptions.

insights.name: Project creation by month
insights.description: Successful CLI/MCP creation and browser ZIP downloads are separate columns. Old events without success stay in an unknown-outcome column. Copied commands and previews are not created projects.

source.query:
SELECT toStartOfMonth(timestamp) AS period,
countIf(event = 'project_created' AND properties.success = true) AS cli_mcp_created,
countIf(event = 'builder_zip_downloaded' AND properties.status = 'succeeded') AS web_zips,
countIf(event = 'project_created' AND properties.success IS NULL) AS historical_unknown_outcome,
countIf(event = 'project_created' AND properties.success = false) AS failed_creates
FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 365 DAY
GROUP BY period ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT 366

insights.name: Project creation by day
insights.description: Successful CLI/MCP creation and browser ZIP downloads are separate columns. Old events without success stay in an unknown-outcome column. Copied commands and previews are not created projects.

source.query:
SELECT toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS period,
countIf(event = 'project_created' AND properties.success = true) AS cli_mcp_created,
countIf(event = 'builder_zip_downloaded' AND properties.status = 'succeeded') AS web_zips,
countIf(event = 'project_created' AND properties.success IS NULL) AS historical_unknown_outcome,
countIf(event = 'project_created' AND properties.success = false) AS failed_creates
FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY period ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT 366

insights.name: Creation sources and setup outcomes
insights.description: Last 30 days. MCP generation does not imply dependencies were installed. Client and source are recorded separately.

source.query:
SELECT event, coalesce(properties.source, 'unknown') AS source,
coalesce(properties.client, 'unknown') AS client, coalesce(properties.setup_outcome, 'unknown') AS setup_outcome, count() AS events
FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event IN ('project_created', 'builder_zip_downloaded')
GROUP BY event, source, client, setup_outcome ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 100

insights.name: Selected libraries on successful creations
insights.description: Last 30 days. Canonical role:ecosystem:tool choices, with at least five creation events per row. Graph selections take precedence. Historical rows without enough selection metadata are omitted. Counts measure adoption, not library quality.

source.query:
SELECT JSONExtractString(arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(properties.library_selections ?? '[]'))) AS selection,
count() AS creations FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
AND ((event = 'project_created' AND properties.success = true) OR (event = 'builder_zip_downloaded' AND properties.status = 'succeeded'))
GROUP BY selection HAVING creations >= 5 ORDER BY creations DESC LIMIT 200

insights.name: Ecosystems on successful creations
insights.description: Last 30 days. A multi-ecosystem project contributes to each selected ecosystem. Totals across ecosystems can exceed project counts.

source.query:
SELECT JSONExtractString(arrayJoin(JSONExtractArrayRaw(properties.ecosystems ?? '[]'))) AS ecosystem,
count() AS creations FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
AND ((event = 'project_created' AND properties.success = true) OR (event = 'builder_zip_downloaded' AND properties.status = 'succeeded'))
GROUP BY ecosystem HAVING creations >= 5 ORDER BY creations DESC LIMIT 20

insights.name: Page engagement and measurement coverage
insights.description: Last 30 days. One row per published page, minimum five views. Cumulative checkpoints use the maximum per page_view_id, never their sum. Missing checkpoints do not count as zero-duration visits. Foreground time can include idle time.

source.query:
SELECT page, count() AS views, countIf(has_engagement > 0) AS measured_views,
round(avgIf(active_ms / 1000, has_engagement > 0), 1) AS avg_foreground_seconds,
round(avgIf(scroll_depth, has_engagement > 0), 1) AS avg_max_scroll_percent
FROM (
SELECT properties.page_view_id AS view_id, properties.page_id AS page,
countIf(event = 'page_viewed') AS has_view,
countIf(event = 'page_engagement') AS has_engagement,
max(toFloat(properties.active_ms)) AS active_ms,
max(toFloat(properties.max_scroll_percent)) AS scroll_depth
FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event IN ('page_viewed', 'page_engagement')
AND properties.page_view_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY view_id, page
) WHERE has_view > 0 GROUP BY page HAVING views >= 5 ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 200

insights.name: Builder visits without a handoff
insights.description: Last 30 days, excluding views with activity in the last 30 minutes. A handoff means copying a command or downloading a ZIP. Time bins are observed foreground time; missing engagement is labeled unknown. This is a behavioral signal, not proof a person was annoyed.

source.query:
SELECT multiIf(has_engagement = 0, 'unknown', active_ms < 10000, 'under 10s', active_ms < 60000, '10-60s', active_ms < 300000, '1-5m', '5m+') AS time_bucket,
count() AS visits, countIf(handoffs = 0) AS without_handoff,
round(avgIf(scroll_depth, handoffs = 0 AND has_engagement > 0), 1) AS avg_dropoff_scroll_percent
FROM (
SELECT properties.page_view_id AS view_id, countIf(event = 'page_viewed') AS has_view,
countIf(event = 'page_engagement') AS has_engagement,
countIf(event IN ('builder_command_copied', 'builder_zip_downloaded') AND properties.status = 'succeeded') AS handoffs,
max(toFloat(properties.active_ms)) AS active_ms, max(toFloat(properties.max_scroll_percent)) AS scroll_depth,
max(timestamp) AS last_activity
FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.page_id IN ('builder', 'shared-builder', 'shared-stack')
AND properties.page_view_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY view_id
) WHERE has_view > 0 AND last_activity < now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
GROUP BY time_bucket HAVING visits >= 5 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 10

insights.name: Builder actions and failures
insights.description: Last 30 days. Run-ready, copied commands, downloads, compatibility recoveries and abandonment remain distinct. Failure fields contain normalized codes only.

source.query:
SELECT event, coalesce(properties.status, 'unknown') AS status,
coalesce(properties.failureStage, 'none') AS stage, coalesce(properties.failureReason, 'none') AS reason,
count() AS events FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event LIKE 'builder_%'
GROUP BY event, status, stage, reason ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 100

insights.name: Anonymous repeat use
insights.description: Last 30 days. Counts observed anonymous devices, excluding legacy events without a UUID. CLI and browser identities are separate; these are not known people.

source.query:
SELECT client, count() AS active_devices, countIf(active_days > 1) AS returning_devices
FROM (SELECT distinct_id, coalesce(properties.client, 'unknown') AS client,
count(DISTINCT toDate(timestamp)) AS active_days FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND properties.identity_quality = 'anonymous-device'
GROUP BY distinct_id, client) GROUP BY client LIMIT 10

insights.name: Analytics events by month
insights.description: Event-time counts over the last year for reconciliation. Historical migration requires a paid-plan enrollment but has no standard ingestion fee. PostHog Billing remains the source for current usage and limits.

source.query:
SELECT toStartOfMonth(timestamp) AS month, count() AS events,
countIf(properties.historical_import = true) AS imported_events,
countIf(event = 'page_viewed') AS pageviews
FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 365 DAY GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 13
